input.subject: Offer of employment - Product Designer
input.text:
Dear Sam,

We are delighted to offer you the position of Product Designer at Quokka Health.

Please find your offer letter attached, which outlines your compensation package and start date. Kindly sign and return the offer letter by 10 October.

Welcome to the team!

Quokka Health People & Culture
